flags.title: One customer is 41% of revenue
flags.detail: C-07 brings 41% of revenue and its contract ends 2026-12-31.

flags.title: Price cut for the biggest customer
flags.detail: C-07 paid $2.50 per GPU-hour until 2026-05-31 and $2.15 from 2026-06-30.

flags.title: 3 invoices paid late
flags.detail: Invoices dated 2026-05-31, 2026-07-31 and 2026-08-31 were paid 31 to 47 days after the due date.

flags.title: A refund of $9,360
flags.detail: C-07 was refunded $9,360 on the invoice dated 2026-03-31 (note: "service credit").

flags.title: 61 hours of downtime in 2026-02
flags.detail: The record for 2026-02-28 notes: "cooling fault, 16 GPUs offline".

memo: Over 14 months the cluster was in use 72% of the time at an average of $2.64 per GPU-hour, and 68% of revenue was under contract. The main worry: C-07 brings 41% of revenue and its contract ends 2026-12-31. Also on record: price cut for the biggest customer, 3 invoices paid late, a refund of $9,360 and 61 hours of downtime in 2026-02.
